accent.rule: Nunca fixar o tema da captura; tinta clara para acento colorido e tinta escura para branco/quase branco.
accent.fallbackRule: When a dynamic theme cannot run (safe profile, title without art or grey art, index from another version) the accent is Rosa, not Branco (owner, 22/11/2026). The fallback paints controls only: the page background, the Frost light and the glass tint stay neutral.
accent.mockupNote: The only rose in the app is #C93C87 (contrast-checked by tests/acentos.sh). The mockups' --ac #EC407A is a drawing placeholder, never a native value.

elevation.default: Glass UI 'ilha' (02/10/2026): every panel is an island in the clock island's material — dark cool core (glass ~80% via gfx_vidro_folha, or solid #121316 when ajustes_vidro()==0), one faint corner light (gfx_luz_canto), short GFX_SOMBRA, no outline, large radius (sheet 28, modal 30-36, row 20-22, pill 50%).
elevation.focus: Row/card focus = one step lighter surface (glass white 12-14%, solid #2B2D34), optional white ring (Contorno do vidro), no accent block. Button/key/chip focus = full pill in the accent with contrast ink.
elevation.accent: Accent only marks state or key elements (active page dot, playing/previous-pick marks, 'Best for this TV', MP4, HDR group tag, chip on).
elevation.badges: Quality logos all in the same white ink (dim off-focus, bright on focus); per-category color was rejected.
elevation.gradients: 8-bit panels band: gradients only through shaders that call nv_dither; never stacked gfx_cor strips. GPU level 1 uses the cheap Bayer dither.

motion.principle: Motion clarifies focus and transition; never carries meaning by itself.
motion.reducedMotion: Remove transitions while retaining the complete selected state.

componentExamples.name: episode-row-rest
componentExamples.nativeSpec: Selectable content card; rounded dark surface #101114; clear title and metadata; no decorative border.

componentExamples.name: episode-row-focused
componentExamples.nativeSpec: One block: the whole card rises one surface step (glass white 12-14%, solid #2B2D34); poster ratio preserved; no ring, no accent wash, no split border.

componentExamples.name: focused-content-row
componentExamples.nativeSpec: Rows in sources, episode actions, side panels and the expanded menu: focused row = one surface step lighter, with a white ring only when Contorno do vidro is on and no accent fill. Only buttons, chips and keys become a full accent pill with contrast ink. Inactive surfaces stay neutral.

componentExamples.name: close-ghost
componentExamples.nativeSpec: No box at rest; subtle neutral surface and standard focus cue only while selected.

componentExamples.name: poster-focused
componentExamples.nativeSpec: Poster rises (NV_FOCO_LIFT, NV_FOCO_ESCALA_P) with a dropped shadow; no ring. A white ring is an accessibility option only.

extensions.rule: A build that does not match the mockup side by side, in both glass and solid, is wrong.

brand.name: Nuvio Legacy
brand.rule: Owner decision 22/11/2026. "Tenzing TV" in older Pencil boards is obsolete.

visualBase.rule: The 2.0 mockups are the visual base: design/glass-ilha (material and focus) and design/2.1 (flows). Later Pencil boards (componentes2.lib.pen) and prototypes contribute pieces only after they are redone in these tokens.

tokens.rule: Glass and solid share geometry; only these values change.
